name: Packing Hall
description:
Standard and bulky parcels use separate benches.

Where should the next packing resource go?

Starting assumptions
• Two hours of demand, routed 75% to standard packing and 25% to bulky packing.
• Both lanes share a packing crew before a common label-check step.
• Routing probabilities represent a synthetic parcel mix; packing materials and inventory are unlimited.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
